description: AT Protocol createAccount, used here to import an account from another PDS.

main.description: Create an account. On this PDS it only imports an existing did (account migration); new accounts use net.openfederation.account.register. Proof of control: a JWT (iss = did, aud = this PDS service DID, lxm = this method) signed by one of the DID's current PLC rotation keys, sent as the Bearer token.

did.description: Pre-existing atproto DID, being imported to a new account.

password.description: Initial account password. May need to meet instance-specific password strength requirements.

recoveryKey.description: DID PLC rotation key (aka, recovery key) to be included in PLC creation operation.

plcOp.description: A signed DID PLC operation to be submitted as part of importing an existing account to this instance. NOTE: this optional field may be updated when full account migration is implemented.

token.description: Blind creation token (net.openfederation.pseudonym.collectTokens). Required for a pseudonym when this PDS's pseudonym migration policy is 'token'; ignored otherwise.

schema.description: Account login session returned on successful account creation.

did.description: The DID of the new account.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No did given: new accounts are created with net.openfederation.account.register.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: The proof JWT is missing a valid signature by a rotation key, is expired or replayed, names another DID, or is not scoped to this method.

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.description: This DID already has an account on this PDS.

errors.name: MigrationNotAllowed
errors.description: This PDS does not accept accounts moving in (policy closed).

errors.name: TokenSpent
errors.description: The creation token was already used.
